$comment: Derived from docs/competitor-audit.md, which records the full methodology. Hand-maintained rather than generated: it encodes judgements about accuracy and product scope that no script can make. Regenerate by re-auditing (quarterly cadence in docs/seo/content-roadmap.md) and updating both files together.

competitors.assessment: The genuine benchmark. Correct rate, correct minimum, cited source, visible verification date and an honest Earned-versus-purchased explanation.
gaps: models only the standard rate, so a mixed balance cannot be calculated

competitors.assessment: Correct rate and genuine multi-currency support, with no way for a reader to tell whether the figure is current.
gaps: no currency provenance or observation date

competitors.assessment: Substantial supporting content built on figures that current official documentation contradicts.

inaccuracies.impact: worked example table understates a 1,000,000 Robux payout by 300 USD
a creator with 50,000 Earned Robux would wrongly conclude they cannot cash out

competitors.assessment: Links the official terms but contradicts itself on the page.

inaccuracies.claim: a minimum of 10,000 earned Robux, and separately 30,000 Robux or more
inaccuracies.impact: two different minimums on one page; the reader cannot tell which is correct

competitors.assessment: The served document contains only a page title. All content requires JavaScript.
gaps: nothing renders without JavaScript, so a crawler or a no-script reader gets nothing

competitors.assessment: Returned 403 Forbidden to an automated request. Not audited; no attempt was made to bypass the restriction.

gaps.description: Rates published with no source and no verification date, so a reader cannot distinguish a current figure from one a year out of date.
gaps.response: Every rate carries a source link and a verification date rendered on the page. The build fails if a rate is unsourced, and the badge changes tone as the registry ages.

gaps.description: Minimum thresholds that contradict official documentation or contradict themselves within one page.
gaps.response: One validated registry is the only source of the minimum. Content referencing a rate that does not exist fails the build.
Rates, formulas, tables, worked examples, FAQs and every link are server rendered. A test asserts each route renders over 800 characters with scripting disabled.

gaps.description: No warning that purchased, gift-card or traded Robux cannot be converted.
gaps.response: Stated next to every result, given its own page, and repeated wherever a payout figure appears.

gaps.description: Only one rate modelled, so a balance spanning the September 2025 transition cannot be calculated.
gaps.response: All three documented rates, a split calculator for a mixed balance, and a comparison table showing what each would pay.

gaps.description: No way to work backwards from a payout goal to the Earned Robux required.
gaps.response: Target mode with round-up logic, the minimum applied, and progress against a current balance.

gaps.description: Converted currency figures with no provider, observation date or indication of staleness.
gaps.response: Provider, observation date and a reference-rates-not-bank-quotes note on every converted figure, with an explicitly labelled stale fallback.

gaps.description: No record of past rates, so a creator holding a legacy balance has nowhere to understand it.
gaps.response: A dated timeline with effective dates and sources, plus a public changelog of this site's own data changes.

gaps.description: Reaching the minimum implied to mean qualifying for a payout.
gaps.response: The threshold meter says 'Meets the stated minimum', never 'eligible'. A test asserts the stronger phrasing appears nowhere on the site.

gaps.description: No methodology, editorial policy, corrections process or accessibility statement.
gaps.response: All four published, each describing actual configured behaviour rather than generic policy text.
